summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by CytoMed Therapeutics Ltd reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 22, 2026. The filing details the adoption of financial statements, re-election of directors, ratification of auditors, approval of directors fees, and authorization to issue shares. All proposals were approved by a majority of shares present. There are no terms of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no event-driven catalyst.
